# Annex G: Use-Case Examples (UC1 to UC7)

This annex relates the guideline to the seven PROTEUS use cases and gives EO-specific examples for each: displacement monitoring (UC1), crop stress (UC2), irrigation (UC3), urban air quality (UC4), wildfires (UC5), flood risk (UC6) and research and education (UC7). For each use case it lists the principles and risks that matter most, for example geoprivacy and social sensitivity in UC1, out-of-distribution detection for crop monitoring in UC2, and calibrated uncertainty for time-critical decisions in UC5 and UC6, together with the lifecycle requirements that need particular attention, the main evidence expected (such as calibrated uncertainty, per-region performance or geoprivacy screening), and the points where human oversight is required before outputs are used. It also describes how the use case leads apply the self-assessment and how the results feed the cross-use-case evaluation of KR06. The examples are kept in this annex so that the core guideline stays applicable to EO applications beyond PROTEUS, and they are updated as the use cases mature.
